reason: I'm on the other side of the world, the build burns cash every day and my admin's spreadsheet is always a week behind, so a free trial with no card costs me nothing to try. If the first 30 receipts come through clean I'll pay for the 200 or 500 plan without thinking about it, because the money is nothing next to one duplicated or padded invoice.
objection: Half of what the site team sends is faded thermal paper or a handwritten nota in Indonesian. If the bot misreads those and I end up correcting totals at midnight, it's just one more thing to babysit.
would_change_my_mind: If the free 30 documents show it getting handwritten Indonesian notas wrong more often than my admin does, I drop it.
